description:
Customer experience is at the heart of all we do at Amazon, as we strive to be Earth's most customer-centric company. Amazon Customer Service (CS) is at the forefront of customer experience, working relentlessly to provide customers with a convenient, high quality, and delightful experience - across all our CS channels, in every interaction.
Within CS, Intent Engineering is responsible for predicting what every customer needs (the item, the issue, and the resolution path) across every channel and touchpoint in Amazon's customer service journey. We are building the AI systems that power intent detection in chat and voice, entity prediction for associates, and full-cycle intent prediction for customer-to-agent routing. We are transforming how Amazon understands its customers at the point of contact, making intent the shared intelligence layer that every customer service experience depends on. 

We are seeking a Software Development Engineer to join the Intent Engineering team building Amazon's AI-powered intent understanding platform, a system that predicts what each customer needs across chat, voice, and agent routing channels in real time at massive scale. Today, our intent coverage spans millions of customer contacts daily, and we are rapidly expanding it through conversational AI models, full-cycle intent prediction, and advanced entity recognition. You will design, build, and operate the ML-serving infrastructure, real-time prediction services, and model deployment pipelines that make every customer service interaction smarter, faster, and more accurate.

This is a high-ownership role on a team that ships fast and iterates based on real customer impact. You will tackle challenging problems spanning real-time ML inference at scale, multi-model orchestration, low-latency prediction serving, and LLM integration across chat and voice channels. You will work closely with applied scientists, product managers, and senior engineers to turn ambiguous customer understanding problems into technical designs and ship them to production. The ideal candidate thrives in ambiguity, cares deeply about code quality and operational excellence, and is energized by building AI systems that directly improve how millions of customers are understood and served every day.


Key job responsibilities
- Partner closely with Applied Scientists to apply best practices for building generative AI applications, including prompt engineering, retrieval systems, and agent-based architectures.
- Design, implement, test, and deploy software components across our full-stack applications, including front-end web experiences and backend services. 
- Write clean, well-tested, production-ready code that others can maintain and extend. 
- Collaborate with team members on technical design, code reviews, and problem-solving, incorporating feedback to continuously improve code quality. 
- Work with product management and applied scientist to build shared understanding of customer requirements and translate them into technical implementations. 
- Contribute to planning, design, implementation, testing, operations, and process improvement. 
- Actively coach other engineers on the team and ensure the best engineering practices are adopted across the team.


About the team
Customer Service Technologies, part of Amazon Customer Service (CS), builds the platforms and products that power Amazon's world-class customer service experiences. Our team of scientists and engineers develops and deploys LLM-based Conversational AI systems that help customers solve their issues and get their questions answered efficiently, as well as associate-facing products that support our customer service workforce.
- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language
- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

 The base salary range for this position is listed below. Your Amazon package will include sign-on payments and restricted stock units (RSUs). Final compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, qualifications, and location.
